verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt file and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks an integrator could use to build one, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
